title: "Asking a person"
description: "A run stops and asks someone on their phone, and keeps who said yes: approvals in every language, a record in the editor, the API and the audit log."
editUrl: false
---

The Ask for approval step stops a run and asks someone. They open a link on their
phone, read what you wrote, fill in a small form if there is one, and press Approve
or Reject, and the run carries on with who answered and what they said. Cascade
keeps each answer as a record, in the editor, the API and the MCP server, and in the
audit log. The page is in all fourteen languages.
